text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин's momentous debut
race is
today.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm fine. I'm a little nervous, it's
true, but...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It's an exhilarating feeling to know that,
starting
now, I'm truly moving toward my
goal.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
This is the first step on the road to
conquering
the Tenno Sho. ...Now, here I
go!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
